title: For British drivers who participated in races at circuits located in Monaco
question: For British drivers who participated in races at circuits located in Monaco during 2005-2015, identify the top 3 drivers by average points. For each of these drivers, also show their earliest race year in Monaco and the total number of races they completed (where finish time is recorded).

WITH monaco_results AS (
  SELECT
    d.XCL_034 AS driver_id,
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    r.XCL_066 AS race_year,
    res.XCL_082 AS points,
    res.XCL_084 AS finish_time
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results res ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
  JOIN races r ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
  JOIN circuits c ON c.XCL_001 = r.XCL_068
  WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'British'
    AND c.XCL_005 = 'Monaco'
    AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
),
driver_stats AS (
  SELECT
    driver_id,
    MAX(forename) AS forename,
    MAX(surname) AS surname,
    AVG(points) AS avg_points,
    MIN(race_year) AS earliest_race_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN finish_time IS NOT NULL AND finish_time <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_races
  FROM monaco_results
  GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT
  forename,
  surname,
  avg_points,
  earliest_race_year,
  completed_races
FROM driver_stats
ORDER BY avg_points DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driverId, d.XCL_038 AS forename, d.XCL_039 AS surname,

),
agg AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename, surname,
         AVG(points) AS avg_points,
         MIN(year) AS earliest_year,
         SUM(CASE WHEN time IS NOT NULL AND time != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed
  FROM base
  GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT forename, surname, avg_points, earliest_year, completed
FROM agg
ORDER BY avg_points DESC
